name: Proof Strength Classification Registry
purpose: Classify each MT candidate by proof strength without promotion inflation.

classification_levels.definition: Candidate exists but has not undergone RPCR audit or review.
Candidate review is halted due to missing substrate dependencies or critical drift.
Candidate is contested by one or more active counterexamples.
Candidate is derivable only if specific, explicitly declared assumptions are granted.
Candidate has satisfied all proof obligations within a restricted neighborhood.
Candidate has passed stress-testing and is ready for formal, non-provisional review.

forbidden_escalations.rule: Promotion to PROVEN is blocked until a formal series closure review is completed.
Mapping theorem results to physical reality is formally prohibited.
The extension of local derivation to global domains is prohibited.
Using proof candidates as evidence for QM/GR unification is prohibited.

governance_rules.rule: No candidate may bypass the classification hierarchy.
Promotion to a higher level requires the satisfaction of all lower-level preconditions.

forbidden_claims: Classification level represents the 'truthfulness' of the framework.
Ready for review status justifies physical substrate claims.
Counterexample active status can be bypassed by increasing neighborhood complexity.
